title: Live reply from /v1/chat/sessions/:id/events
evidence: useConversation.ts reads event: message (history), event: chat (claude frames, managed) and event: runtime (registered host). Runtime path replayed by Gate B (H5) as a registered claude host sends it since Barkpark #25471: one turn_started, each text block as an item, so two text blocks land as two bubbles (the older host's turn_started per message still replays with --shape legacy). History rows claim the live bubbles instead of doubling them, as one row per turn: Barkpark stores every message's text joined, from either host (since #25471; before, only the last); Gate B drops and reconnects the stream after each turn and replays it (proof: the old one-bubble claim showed a third bubble of 329 characters). Seen live 2026-11-11: a message typed in the app (vite dev, real Barkpark, the Mac host) came back as a reply bubble and 'BarkBot replied'. Found there and fixed: a reloaded page showed no history, because Barkpark replays stored rows only after a Last-Event-ID and the first connect sent none; /api/chat/$id/events now asks from 0. Gate B does not cover that route (its stand-in stream replays without the header). Missing: a live turn with tools, and a mid-turn reload.
